caption_sources.llmcaption: Qwen3-VL-8B; the archived local RSICD generator used LM Studio.
caption_sources.llmcaption2: MiniCPM-V-2.6 in the full-corpus variant; not Qwen3-VL-2B.
caption_sources.metadata: Structured image metadata rendered as text, not LLM captioning.

descriptive.epoch_ablation: Historical run records only, unmatched seed sets and references; do not compare as a matched schedule.
descriptive.full_10k: Official splits; source-specific evaluation pools and actual training counts.
descriptive.other: Official-split configuration scores, not shared-reference estimates; variants may differ in reference pools.
descriptive.scale_50k: Historical standalone records only; no matched 10k versus 50k comparison.

excluded: Pre-fix subset runs evaluated on training images, including superseded local and remote subset exports.
Historical scaling and epoch aggregates that imply a matched comparison, and dependent composite summaries.
Per-image captions, images, weights, corpus manifests with individual rows, and example captions.
held_out: Corrected subset runs with image-level CRC32 holdout; split membership and reference content are distinct controls.
paired_rsicd: Held-out shared human references, matched ordered training images; 2 and 6 epochs are different schedules, not a fixed learning-rate continuation.
transfer: Same-corpus is a source/target relationship; it does not mean training-set evaluation. Cross-corpus cells are separate single-seed results.
